_note: The Chamber of Commerce facts of a client that is an organisation, as the Organisations list and the organisation page show them (boards PqOrganisaties, PqOrganisatie): the KvK number, the legal form, the place of establishment and a short description of what the organisation does. A client that is a person carries none of them. They sit on `client` itself rather than on a separate company record, because an organisation in pipelinq is a client with type organization and every list, form and relation already points there.
